subjects.title: Count Dracula
subjects.prose: Count Dracula, a tall gaunt old nobleman with a long white moustache, a high hooked nose, arched eyebrows, pale skin, pointed ears and sharp white teeth showing at his lip, dressed from head to foot in black with a high collar and a long black cloak, stands with one pale hand raised in a courtly welcome.
subjects.camera: Medium full shot at eye level, three-quarter view, the single figure centred in front of a plain dark stone wall.

forms.krea2: Count Dracula, a tall, gaunt old nobleman with pale skin, a long white moustache, a high hooked nose, arched eyebrows, pointed ears and sharp white teeth showing at his lip, is dressed from head to foot in black, with a high collar and a long black cloak. He stands alone in three-quarter view, one pale hand raised at chest height, palm open in a courtly welcome, head inclined slightly forward, brows arched high. It is night indoors, a single low light falling on him from one side. Medium full shot at eye level, three-quarter view, the single figure centred in front of a plain dark stone wall.
forms.flux3_klein: Medium full shot at eye level in three-quarter view of a single figure centred before a plain dark stone wall in a castle hall at night, lit from the left by an oil-lamp flame in an iron bracket at the left edge of the frame, a hard side light that throws his shadow onto the wall at the right. In the centre stands Count Dracula, a tall, gaunt old nobleman with pale skin, thinning white hair swept back, a long white moustache, a high hooked nose, arched eyebrows, pointed ears and sharp white teeth showing at his lip. He is dressed from head to foot in black, with a high collar closed at the throat and a long black cloak falling to his ankles. His body turns toward the left, his face toward the viewer, and his pale right hand is raised to chest height, palm open and turned outward, in a courtly welcome. Behind him, large squared dark stone blocks fill the frame from edge to edge, his shadow lying across them on the right.
forms.qwen_image_2_1: He is seen in a medium full shot at eye level, framed from the knees up in a three-quarter view, the single figure standing at the centre of the frame. Behind him, a plain dark stone wall of large fitted blocks fills the background from edge to edge, and worn flagstones show just above the bottom edge. The figure is Count Dracula, a tall, gaunt old nobleman with narrow shoulders, a long lean frame and an upright, courtly posture. At the top of the figure, his head is held high, with what appears to be thin white hair swept back from a high forehead. His face has pale skin, a high hooked nose, arched eyebrows, pointed ears and a long white moustache drooping past the corners of his mouth. At his lip, sharp white teeth show, and his gaze is turned directly toward the viewer. He is dressed from head to foot in black, in a long black coat of fine wool buttoned to the throat beneath a high black collar. Across his shoulders hangs a long black cloak of heavy wool, falling in deep folds down both sides past the bottom edge of the frame. In front of his chest, one pale hand is raised in a courtly welcome, palm open, the long fingers appearing to end in pointed nails. On the left and right sides of the frame, the bare wall leaves an even margin around him, and in the upper corners the blocks recede into darkness. The lighting is a single source from the front at head height, picking out the pale face, the raised hand and the edges of the cloak, while the wall behind him falls into shadow.
forms.flux3_klein_bfl: The scene is a stone interior, framed as a medium full shot at eye level in three-quarter view, with the single figure centred in front of a plain dark stone wall and cut at the knees. A single hard light comes from the upper left at a cool white temperature, lighting the left side of his face, his high collar and his raised hand, and casting his shadow onto the wall at the right. In the center stands Count Dracula, a tall, gaunt old nobleman, a white man in his seventies with pale skin, thin white hair swept back from a high forehead, a long white moustache, a high hooked nose, arched eyebrows, pointed ears and sharp white teeth showing at his lip. He is dressed from head to foot in black: a black coat buttoned to the throat beneath a high collar, black trousers, and a long black cloak that hangs from his shoulders in deep folds past the lower edge of the frame. His body turns toward frame-left while his face turns toward the camera. His right hand is raised to chest height, pale and long-fingered, palm open and turned outward in a courtly welcome, and his left hand hangs at his side inside the fall of the cloak. Behind him, the plain dark stone wall of large squared blocks fills the frame from edge to edge, its upper corners falling into shadow.

subjects.title: Castle Dracula
subjects.prose: Castle Dracula, a vast ruined Gothic castle of black stone with broken battlements and a few lit windows, stands on the edge of a sheer precipice above a dark pine forest in the Carpathian mountains at dusk, under a darkening violet sky. No people.
subjects.camera: Extreme wide establishing shot from a low angle, a wide-angle sweep, the castle small against an enormous sky in the upper third of the frame.

forms.krea2: Castle Dracula, a vast ruined Gothic castle of black stone with broken battlements and a few lit windows, stands on the edge of a sheer precipice above a dark pine forest in the Carpathian mountains. It is dusk: the last light lies low along the horizon under a darkening violet sky, and the lit windows are the only points of light on the castle. The scene is empty of people. Extreme wide establishing shot from a low angle, a sweeping wide-angle view, the castle small against an enormous sky in the upper third of the frame, the precipice and forest below.
forms.flux3_klein: Extreme wide establishing shot from a low angle with a wide-angle lens, looking up from a dark pine forest toward a sheer precipice in the Carpathian mountains at dusk, under a darkening violet sky, the last daylight low behind the ridge on the left and a few lit castle windows the only other light. In the upper third of the frame, Castle Dracula stands small on the very edge of the precipice: a vast ruined Gothic castle of black stone with towers, high walls and broken battlements, a few small windows lit from within. Below it the precipice drops as a sheer face of black rock into the forest. Across the lower third, the dark pine forest fills the frame from edge to edge, the nearest pointed tops large at the bottom edge. The enormous violet sky fills the upper two thirds around the small castle, with jagged dark mountain ridges on both sides. The frame contains only the castle, the rock, the forest, the ridges and the sky.
forms.qwen_image_2_1: The castle is seen in an extreme wide establishing view from a low angle, a wide-angle sweep in which it stands small against an enormous sky in the upper third of the frame. A darkening violet dusk sky fills most of the frame, deepening toward the top edge, with a few thin clouds likely catching the last light. Across the middle of the frame, jagged Carpathian mountain ridges run from the left edge to the right edge. In the upper third, near the centre, stands Castle Dracula, a vast ruined Gothic castle of black stone with broken battlements and crumbling towers. A few of its narrow windows are lit, small points of yellow lamplight in the black walls. The castle stands on the very edge of a sheer precipice, a cliff of bare rock dropping straight down beneath its walls. On the left side of the frame, the cliff face falls away into the valley. On the right side, a lower ridge of rock and scattered pines slopes down toward the valley floor. Below the precipice, a dark pine forest of dense, pointed treetops spreads across the lower half of the frame to both side edges. In the bottom corners, the nearest pine trunks rise close to the camera, leaning inward because of the low angle. The mountainside is deserted, holding only stone, sky and trees. The lighting is the fading dusk glow from behind the mountains, low and diffuse, leaving the castle and the cliff as dark masses against the brighter sky, the lit windows as small warm points and the forest below in near darkness.
forms.flux3_klein_bfl: The scene is an outdoor mountain landscape in the Carpathian mountains at dusk, framed as an extreme wide establishing shot from a low angle with a wide-angle lens that sweeps across the whole range. The sun has set behind the ridges on the left, and the remaining light is low, diffuse and cool, coming from that side under a darkening violet sky; the only other light comes from a few lit windows in the castle, small points of warm yellow. In the upper third of the frame, Castle Dracula stands small against the enormous sky on the very edge of a sheer precipice: a vast ruined Gothic castle of black stone with tall towers, high curtain walls, broken battlements and gaps where sections of wall have fallen, a few narrow windows lit from within. Below the castle, the precipice drops as a sheer face of black rock, its vertical cracks and ledges catching the last light on their left edges. Across the lower third, a dark pine forest spreads from the left edge to the right edge, the pointed tops of the nearest pines large along the bottom of the frame and leaning inward with the low angle. In the background, jagged dark mountain ridges rise on both sides of the castle, and the violet sky fills the upper two thirds, deepening toward the top. The frame holds only stone, rock, trees and sky.

subjects.title: Harker arrives at the castle
subjects.prose: At night in a dark stone courtyard, Jonathan Harker, a young English solicitor in a brown travelling coat holding a leather bag, stands beside a horse-drawn carriage facing a great old wooden door studded with iron nails; in the open doorway the tall old Count in black holds up an antique silver lamp whose flame throws long shadows across the stones.
subjects.camera: Wide shot from behind the young man's shoulder at eye level, the lit doorway framed at the centre of the frame.

forms.krea2: At night in a dark stone courtyard, Jonathan Harker, a young English solicitor in a brown travelling coat holding a leather bag, stands with his back to us beside a horse-drawn carriage, facing a great old wooden door studded with iron nails. In the open doorway the tall old Count, dressed in black, holds up an antique silver lamp; its flame is the only light, throwing long shadows across the stones. Wide shot from behind the young man's shoulder at eye level, his shoulder and back in the near foreground, the lit doorway framed at the centre of the frame.
forms.flux3_klein: Wide shot at eye level from behind the right shoulder of a young man in a dark stone courtyard at night, the open doorway framed at the centre, the only light the flame of an antique silver lamp held up in that doorway, throwing long shadows across the stones. In the right foreground, Jonathan Harker, a young English solicitor of slim build with fair skin and short brown hair, stands with his back to the camera in a brown travelling coat, a leather bag in his right hand, facing the door. On the left beside him stands a horse-drawn carriage, a dark closed coach with two dark horses in harness. At the centre, a great old wooden door studded with iron nails stands open, and in the doorway stands the Count, a tall, gaunt old nobleman with pale skin, thinning white hair swept back and a long white moustache, dressed from head to foot in black with a long black cloak, holding the silver lamp up in his right hand. Dark stone walls rise around the doorway to the top edge under a strip of black sky.
forms.qwen_image_2_1: The scene is seen in a wide shot at eye level from just behind the young man's shoulder, with the lit doorway framed at the centre of the frame. It is night in a dark stone courtyard enclosed by high walls of rough stone, and the ground is paved with uneven old flagstones. Along the top edge, the walls and battlements cut against a black night sky. At the centre of the frame, set into the far wall, a great old wooden door studded with rows of iron nails stands open. In the open doorway stands the tall old Count, a gaunt old nobleman with a long white moustache and pale skin, dressed from head to foot in black with a high collar and a long black cloak. He holds up an antique silver lamp at head height, its flame throwing long shadows across the stones. In the left foreground, Jonathan Harker, a young English solicitor of slim build, is seen from behind, his shoulder and the back of his head large in the frame. He has short brown hair and fair skin, wears a brown travelling coat of heavy wool, and holds a leather bag at his side, his gaze on the doorway. On the right side of the frame, beside him, stands a horse-drawn carriage, a dark wooden coach with tall spoked wheels, drawn by what appear to be four horses. Across the bottom of the frame, the flagstones run toward the camera, and in the corners the courtyard walls fall into darkness. The lighting is the single lamp flame in the doorway, a small hard source that lights the Count's face and hand from below and spills across the threshold, throwing long shadows back across the stones.
forms.flux3_klein_bfl: The scene is an outdoor stone courtyard at night, framed as a wide shot at eye level from behind the young man's right shoulder, with the lit open doorway at the centre of the frame. The only light is the flame of an antique silver lamp held up in that doorway: a small, hard, warm yellow source at head height that lights the threshold and the door and throws long shadows back across the paving stones toward the camera. In the right foreground, Jonathan Harker, a young English solicitor, a white man in his twenties with fair skin and short brown hair, stands with his back to the camera, his right shoulder and the back of his head large in the frame. He wears a brown travelling coat of heavy wool, holds a leather bag in his right hand and faces the door. On the left beside him stands a horse-drawn carriage, a dark closed coach on tall spoked wheels with two dark horses in harness, its side edged by the lamplight. At the centre, a great old wooden door studded with rows of iron nails stands open, and in the open doorway stands the tall old Count, a gaunt white man in his seventies with pale skin, thin white hair and a long white moustache, dressed from head to foot in black with a long black cloak, holding the silver lamp up in his right hand. In the background, the dark stone walls of the courtyard rise to the top edge on all sides and turn black above the doorway.

subjects.title: Mina writes her journal
subjects.prose: Mina Harker, a young Victorian woman with dark hair pinned up, in a high-necked pale blue blouse, sits at a small writing desk in a bedroom at night writing in a leather-bound journal with a dip pen, a single candle burning beside an open window where the net curtains stir.
subjects.camera: Tight close-up over her left shoulder, her face in three-quarter profile and the candle flame at the right edge of the frame, the room behind her falling soft.

forms.krea2: Mina Harker, a young Victorian woman with dark hair pinned up, in a high-necked pale blue blouse, sits at a small writing desk in a bedroom at night, writing in a leather-bound journal with a dip pen, eyes lowered to the page, head bent slightly forward. A single candle burns beside an open window where the net curtains stir; its flame is the only light, falling on her cheek, her hand and the page. Tight close-up over her left shoulder, her face in three-quarter profile and the candle flame at the right edge of the frame, the room behind her falling soft.
forms.flux3_klein: Tight close-up over the left shoulder of Mina Harker, a young Victorian woman with fair skin and dark hair pinned up, her face in three-quarter profile turned toward the right, the flame of a single candle at the right edge of the frame. She wears a high-necked pale blue blouse with long sleeves, her left shoulder and pinned hair large in the left foreground. She sits at a small writing desk in a bedroom at night, leaning forward, her eyes lowered to a leather-bound journal open before her, her right hand holding a dip pen to the page above rows of small dark handwriting. The candle on the desk is the only light: its upright flame lights her cheek, her hand and the page from the right with a hard light, and her near shoulder falls into shadow. Beyond the desk and out of focus stand an open window beside the candle, white net curtains stirring inward from it, and the plain dim shapes of the bedroom wall.
forms.qwen_image_2_1: The scene is seen in a tight close-up over her left shoulder, her face in three-quarter profile and the candle flame at the right edge of the frame. Behind her, the bedroom falls out of focus, a papered wall and furniture reading only as indistinct forms. Along the bottom of the frame lies the top of a small writing desk of dark polished wood. In the centre of the frame sits Mina Harker, a young Victorian woman of slender build, upright and leaning slightly toward the desk. Her dark hair is pinned up in a neat coil at the back of her head, a few loose strands at the nape. Her fair skin and straight nose are seen in three-quarter profile, her lowered gaze fixed on the page. She wears a high-necked pale blue blouse of fine cotton, with a close collar at the throat and long sleeves. On the left side of the frame, her left shoulder fills the near edge. Below her face, her right hand holds a dip pen whose steel nib touches the page of a leather-bound journal lying open on the desk, its pages carrying lines of small handwriting. At the right edge of the frame, a single candle burns in what appears to be a brass holder. Beyond it, on the right side, an open window shows the night, its white net curtains stirring inward. In the bottom left corner, her left hand rests flat on the desk, steadying the journal. The lighting is the single candle flame at the right, a small warm source that lights the side of her face, her hand and the open page, leaving the room behind her in shadow.
forms.flux3_klein_bfl: The scene is a bedroom at night, framed as a tight close-up over the left shoulder of a young woman seated at a small writing desk, her face in three-quarter profile and the flame of a single candle at the right edge of the frame, with the room behind her out of focus. subjects.title: The race to the castle at sunset
subjects.prose: At sunset on a snowy mountain road, four horsemen in heavy winter coats, an old doctor with a grey beard, a tall man with a rifle, a young lord and a young solicitor, gallop towards a heavy wooden cart carrying a large wooden box, driven by men in sheepskin coats, snow flying up from the hooves.
subjects.camera: High-angle wide action shot tilted into a Dutch angle, the riders sweeping diagonally across the frame from lower left to upper right.

forms.krea2: At sunset on a snowy mountain road, four horsemen in heavy winter coats gallop hard, leaning low over their horses' necks: an old doctor with a grey beard, a tall man with a rifle, a young lord and a young solicitor. Ahead of them a heavy wooden cart carrying a large wooden box is driven by men in sheepskin coats. Snow flies up from the hooves, and the low sun rakes its last light across the snow. High-angle wide action shot tilted into a Dutch angle, the riders sweeping diagonally across the frame from lower left to upper right, the cart near the upper right.
forms.flux3_klein: High-angle wide action shot tilted into a Dutch angle, looking down on a snowy mountain road at sunset, the low sun at the upper right throwing long shadows of riders and horses across the snow toward the lower left. Four horsemen in heavy winter coats gallop along a diagonal from the lower left of the frame toward the upper right, snow flying up from the hooves: in front, a tall man in a dark brown coat with a rifle across his saddle; beside him, a young lord with dark hair in a dark blue coat; behind them, a young solicitor of slim build with fair skin and short brown hair in a brown coat; last, an old doctor with a grey beard in a grey coat and a fur hat. In the upper right, ahead of them on the road, a heavy wooden cart carrying a large wooden box is pulled by two horses and driven by two men in sheepskin coats. Snow-covered slopes, dark rocks and a few dark pines line the road, and white peaks rise at the top edge under the sunset sky.
forms.qwen_image_2_1: The scene is seen in a wide action view from a high angle, tilted into a Dutch angle, with the riders sweeping diagonally across the frame from the lower left toward the upper right. It is sunset on a snowy mountain road, the road cutting a diagonal band of trampled snow and wheel ruts between snow-covered slopes. Along the top of the frame, snowy peaks and pine slopes catch the last light, the low sun near the horizon. Near the upper right, a heavy wooden cart carrying a large wooden box, drawn by what appear to be two horses, labours up the road. It is driven by men in shaggy sheepskin coats, likely three of them, one at the reins. Across the centre and lower left, four horsemen in heavy winter coats gallop toward the cart, leaning forward in their saddles, their gazes fixed on it. Leading them, an old doctor of stocky build with a grey beard wears a dark grey wool greatcoat. Beside him, a tall lean man in a long brown wool coat holds a rifle. Behind them rides a young lord in a black wool greatcoat with a fur collar, and last a slim young solicitor in a brown travelling coat of heavy wool. The riders have fair skin and hats pulled low. In the bottom left corner, the nearest horse's hooves kick snow toward the camera, and along the right edge a steep drop of snowy rock and pines falls away. The lighting is the low setting sun from the upper right, raking across the snow, catching the riders' faces and the snow flying up from the hooves, and stretching long shadows of the horses back toward the lower left.
forms.flux3_klein_bfl: The scene is an outdoor snowy mountain road at sunset, framed as a high-angle wide action shot tilted into a Dutch angle, the riders sweeping diagonally across the frame from the lower left to the upper right. The sun sits low near the horizon at the upper right, a hard, warm orange light that rakes across the snow and stretches long blue shadows of the horses and riders back toward the lower left. Four horsemen in heavy winter coats gallop along the road in a loose diagonal file, leaning forward over their horses' necks, snow flying up from the hooves. Leading them, nearest the cart, is a tall man with a rifle, a white man in his thirties with fair skin and a dark moustache, in a long brown coat and a wide-brimmed hat, the rifle held across his saddle. Beside him rides a young lord, a white man in his twenties with fair skin and short dark hair, in a black greatcoat with a fur collar. Behind them rides a young solicitor, a white man in his twenties with fair skin and short brown hair, in a brown travelling coat. Last, at the lower left, rides an old doctor, a white man in his sixties with fair skin and a grey beard, in a grey coat and a fur hat. In the upper right, ahead of them on the road, a heavy wooden cart carrying a large wooden box is pulled by two horses and driven by two men in sheepskin coats. Snow-covered slopes, dark rocks and scattered pines line both sides of the road, and white peaks rise along the top edge.
